description: Practical guidance for configuring and using the Serena semantic coding agent and its MCP server.

defaultPrompt: Help me set up Serena for my coding client using its current official instructions.
Use Serena-style semantic navigation to understand this codebase before proposing changes.
Guide me through a safe, symbol-aware refactor and verification plan with Serena.
interface.longDescription: A repository-grounded workflow guide for installing, connecting, activating, and using Serena's MCP-based semantic code navigation, editing, refactoring, and debugging capabilities. It guides coding tasks but does not itself host or connect to the Serena MCP server.

name: serena-coding-agent
